whitelist.title: Whitelist
whitelist.subtitle: Websites agents may open and control. Nothing outside this list is reachable.
whitelist.empty_description: Add a website to let Athena and your personas work inside it. A controllability scan grades how much each site lets an agent do.
whitelist.open_needs_enabled: Allow this site before opening it.
whitelist.select_site: Pick a site to see what an agent can do there
whitelist.toggle_failed: Could not change whether this site is allowed
whitelist.scan_failed_toast: The controllability scan could not finish

add_site.title: Add a website
add_site.origin_hint: Scheme and host only, with an optional port. No path, no query.
add_site.label_hint: What you call this site. The address is used when you leave it blank.
add_site.scan_now_hint: Opens the site once with read-only tools to grade how much of it an agent can work. Nothing is enabled by a scan.
add_site.pattern_hint_subdomain: the site and every subdomain under it
add_site.pattern_hint_example: added for you as an example. Remove it if you do not want it.
add_site.origin_error_url: That is a full web address. Keep the scheme, the host and an optional port, and drop the rest.
add_site.origin_error_wildcard: A * is only allowed as a leading *. on the host, or as the whole port.

scan_report.never_scanned: This site has not been scanned, so nobody knows what an agent could do here.
scan_report.transport_webmcp_native: The page publishes its own tools

detail.hands_description: What an agent can do on any page it can reach, without the page offering anything: it acts on elements the scan found, never on a guess.
detail.hands_budget: Up to {budget} calls per turn on this site.
detail.hands_unavailable: A scan has to grade this site before an agent can act on it.
detail.login_description: Bind a vault credential and the app can sign the agent in. The values never reach the model, a snapshot or a screenshot.
detail.login_no_credentials: Your vault has no credentials yet
detail.login_form_found: The scan found one, so signing in is possible.
detail.login_form_missing: The scan found none, so signing in is not possible yet.
detail.policy_description: Force a tool to ask you first. You can always tighten; you can never loosen a tool below what the page itself implies.
detail.policy_no_tools: This site publishes no tools of its own
detail.policy_budget_hint: How many calls an agent may make on this site in one turn.
detail.policy_override_failed: Could not change that tool's policy

webview.title: Webview
webview.subtitle: The embedded browser you and your agents share.
webview.empty_description: Open a whitelisted website here, or let an agent open one for you.
webview.slot_idle: Open a whitelisted website to see it here.
webview.revoke_failed: Could not take this tab back
webview.pending_body: Waiting for your answer on the orb before this tab changes.
webview.suggestions_none: Not on the Whitelist. Add it there first.

twin.no_active_twin: Pick a twin in Twin → Profiles
twin.armed_hint: Click the box in the page you want your twin to write in.
twin.inserted: Draft inserted into "{label}". Edit it in the page, then send it there or submit here.
